verdict.rationale: Workers' serverless/isolate model, CLI (wrangler) and local simulator (workers-sdk/miniflare) support fast, git/CI-friendly dev workflows that imply many parallel environments, and community testimonials praise quick iteration, but no evidence pack item explicitly confirms 'unlimited isolated environments per team' (e.g., preview URLs, per-branch envs) and some devs cite CPU/runtime limits and lock-in as friction.
